INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1."XCL_063" = T2."XCL_099"
INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T4 ON T1."XCL_072" = T4."XCL_082"

SELECT 
    fd.XCL_079 AS italian_name
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    foreign_data fd ON c.XCL_072 = fd.XCL_082
JOIN 
    legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
JOIN 
    sets s ON c.XCL_012 = s.XCL_099

    AND l.XCL_084 = 'Legal'

ORDER BY 
    c.XCL_014 DESC
